left.title: “Pro-Life” Congressman Caught Telling His Extramarital Boo to Get an Abortion
left.body: Hypocrisy sucks, but unveiling it can feel as satisfying as taking a gigantic gulp of ice-cold nervous sweat from the brow of a very bad man. Such is the sensation that the reporters at the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette must be experiencing in the wake of the marvelous scoop they published Tuesday afternoon: Rep. Tim Murphy, a vocally anti-abortion congressman from Pennsylvania, asked his own girlfriend to terminate a pregnancy this year.
left.roundup: Rep. Tim Murphy, a Republican congressman who is vocally pro-life, will resign amid reports that he asked his mistress to have an abortion. He recently supported legislation that would criminalize abortion after 20 weeks of pregnancy.

center.title: U.S. congressman to resign after report alleged he asked woman to have an abortion
center.body: U.S. Republican Representative Tim Murphy will resign from Congress on Oct. 21, House Speaker Paul Ryan said on Thursday, following a report alleging that Murphy had asked a woman with whom he was having an affair to get an abortion.

right.title: Tim Murphy resigns after revelations he urged mistress to get an abortion
right.body: Rep. Tim Murphy resigned his seat in Congress Thursday, days after court documents revealed the conservative Republican urged a mistress to obtain an abortion.
